sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the State appears on advance notice.

The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in FIR 17:20:52 IST Reason:
No.87 dated 02.12.2023 for the offcences punishable under Sections 323, 406 &
498A of the Indian Penal Code registered at Police Station PS Women, District Police Commissionerate Ludhiana, Punjab.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail subject to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer in the above stated FIR No.87 dated 02.12.2023.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (MANOJ KUMAR)
